notes.title: Ver.1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ver.1.02 Patch Notes

 Slightly adjusted the visuals in Course 302 for a smoother experience.
 Increased the falling speed in Normal Mode of Course 303 to improve game balance. 
 Fixed part of the course layout in Course 303 to enhance playability. 
 Corrected some collision detection issues in Course 401 to resolve hitbox problems.
 Added 4 hidden items, "PopcornShrimp," to the EX Mode of Course 401, increasing exploration fun.

notes.title: Ver.1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Added a Quit button to the Title screen to allow exiting the game.
 Changed the Pause screen so that pressing the ESC key or the Gamepad’s FaceButtonTop returns to the Title screen.
 Reduced the processing load of Course401.
 Fixed several minor bugs.
